about.name: About me
about.intro: Welcome to the website "un oeil sur le code" also translatable by "keep an eye on code". I handmade everything on this site, even translation errors, to show my skills. You could find my projects and creations, languages and frameworks I use, as well as my contact details.
about.question: Why "un oeil sur le code" or "keep an eye on code" ?
about.response:
I didn't want to use my name like many developers who have a portfolio site.
This site was supposed to serve as a portfolio.
But I wanted to make a developer's blog, a devblog, to show the evolution of my projects, and centralized my knowledges...
I had another idea, exploring old codes in BASIC, Assembleur, etc, and adapting them to "newer" languages.
I wanted to keep an eye on code to do my own experience. Now you see the link with the name of my website ;)
about.presentation:
Hi, my name is Kevin Cailly, I'm { age }, and I'm addict to... uh no I'm just a software developer.
By this portfolio, I hope you will understand I'm a computer scientist who masters a bit of all the computer fields !
My strength ? Even if I'm specialized on embedded systems, I can switch from developing a firmware to developing a mobile app, or to developing and deploying a website.
